# Add your headshot here

Upload your portrait into this folder using the exact lowercase filename:

`headshot.jpg`

Full repository path: `dist/assets/profile/headshot.jpg`

Use an actual JPEG image. If your photo is PNG, HEIC, or another format, export it as JPEG instead of only changing its filename. A 4:5 portrait crop at about 800 × 1000 pixels or larger works well; leave room around your head and shoulders.

Commit the upload to the branch used for deployment, then deploy the updated site (or let your configured automatic deployment run). The About page will show it automatically. No HTML, CSS, or JavaScript edits are needed.

Until a valid photo is available, the existing TYC placeholder stays visible. Replace this same file to update your portrait later. If a previous photo remains in your browser after deployment, refresh the page without its cache.

This folder is ready for your headshot upload in this GitHub repository. Uploading a file to GitHub does not by itself update the current ChatGPT-hosted Site; a deployment of that source is still required.
